open_task_surface.sharedTemplateContract: The page controller keeps this surface mounted through the shared template: mountPageTemplate hosts the card marker in its explicit primary slot. The template owns only placement and the single detail/focus carrier; it does not read liveness facts, own the EventSource, or change task state.

derive_liveness_facts.productionEvidence: service.ts:1992 在 taskDashboard() 内调用 runtimeLivenessInput(task, this.now().toISOString())，taskDashboardWithPlan() 在此基础上附加 plan，故 GET /api/tasks/{taskId}/dashboard 一定携带 liveness；active 取自 lifecycle state（running/settling），lastActivityAt 取 requestIdentity.occurredAt 与 events[last].occurredAt 中较新者，record.updatedAt 被显式排除

project_liveness_state.productionEvidence: 既有 projectRuntimeTaskDashboard 投影真实 liveness；P0 合同要求 waiting-for-answer 只在有真实 question/options 时产生。缺 exact execution grant 必须使用独立授权等待事实，系统阻塞保留 typed error，不得仅按 lifecycle waiting/blocked 泛化。

hold_transport_fact.productionEvidence: docs/ui/task.js subscribeTaskStream 在 running/settling 时持有 EventSource，onopen 记 connected，受 terminalClosed/closingStream 保护的 onerror 记 lost，execution.terminal+terminalPhase==='final' 记 settled；setTransportState 就地重渲染，effectiveTransport 把终态收拢成 settled，因此服务端按契约关闭流不会被误报成传输丢失。已建立的流在静默掉线时不会触发 onerror，所以刷新失败也被记为 lost，成功读回则重开流并由 onopen 清除 lost。无法解析的 SSE 帧不算心跳，记 lost（不把损坏流当作健康进展）。四值事实写入卡片自己的 cardMetadata.stream，不写 cardMetadata.transport（契约 packages/ui/contracts/runtime.ts 明确传输事实不下发，只能由持有该流的页面本地判定）

forward_to_work_card.productionEvidence: 现有 projectInteractionCard 输出 cardMetadata 的 liveness/stream 与 runtime stateLabel。P0 合同要求同一转发链同时携带 semantic title、真实 result/blocker、business/occurrence lineage 和已验证主 action；不得只把 currentState 与 nextStep 机械拼接给卡片。

render_work_card_truth.productionEvidence: 既有 renderStatus 已渲染 liveness/stream 并以 runtime stateLabel 代替原始 lifecycle。P0 合同要求它显示真实结果或结果入口、区分授权等待/决策/系统阻塞、只渲染有入口的 actions，并停止把 succeeded 与“可停止”下一步无条件下发。既有 browser 用例不是本 P0 的验收证据。
render_work_card_truth.pageLifecycleContract: The page controller owns transport/stream and card projection state; on page exit it stops its poll/EventSource, disposes the work card, then disposes the shared template. No template-level second composer or second detail dialog is created; the interaction card host stays valid through the shared template.
